title: AV sync threshold grid for coin-clink foley pilot
purpose: Provides a perceptual-threshold decision table and recommended Condition-C delay grid for the A/B/C foley experiment proposed by Iris (artifact 9355e178) and Scout (artifact cdce7e6b). Extends Scout's single 200 ms delay into three bracketing values that test the simultanity window, lag-tolerance boundary, and above-tolerance zone for impact-transient material. Computed from documented Genjutsu frame mismatch (art_01M62F0ZS93GC6702ZF8E99AST r1). Perceptual threshold values are established psychoacoustics literature values, not from cited records.
